label: copy-phase input s (fed-back s), short sequences near the end
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input token is s (99.6% of activation mass). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, and never on any other token except rare weak hits on t/p/b. It fires on only about 12-26% of copy-phase s inputs, so magnitude and whether it fires depend on position. It is strongest in short sequences (L=3-5) and when few outputs remain (to_go<=2). Top activations are s as the second original token of an L=3 sequence, re-fed at the last copy step (e.g. k s t <DEL> k [s]). It is weak or silent for s early in the copy phase of long sequences (L=8-9). Input s in copy phase alone: dev P=0.26 R=0.99 mass recall 1.00. Adding L<=7 and to_go<=2: P=0.56 R=0.78 mass recall 0.89. The length/position modulation is graded, so a boolean cut cannot capture it cleanly.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: s, t, b, p, k, y; least: 3, f, q, w) and the token being output (most: s, t, j, k, b, y; least: l, 1, x, -); timing cues that raise it most: L=3, L=3 & t=4, recall_idx=3.
